sources.title: Zimbabwe Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Trade: passport services
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Trade, Government of Zimbabwe
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Zimbabwe MFA service description expressly distinguishes ordinary, service and diplomatic passports among official documents issued to Zimbabweans.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Facilitate the issuance of all official documents such as ordinary, service and diplomatic passports.

sources.title: Cuba Travel: regulations for travelling to Cuba
sources.officialityEvidence: Cuba's current official tourism portal requires a tourist visa for non-residents, identifies Chinese citizens as the visa-exempt exception, and offers electronic tourist-visa processing online from anywhere outside the United States.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The tourist visa is mandatory ... if you do not have Cuban residency; it is requested through the Internet from anywhere except the United States.

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire official SNEDAI: e-visa procedure
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, official Côte d'Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: SNEDAI identifies itself as the only visa-application website approved by Côte d'Ivoire and says that, after approved pre-enrolment, the visa is printed and issued at the airport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le demandeur embarque avec le document « Pré-enrôlement approuvé » ... le visa est imprimé et délivré immédiatement.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: tourism e-Visa
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Nigeria Immigration Service agreement calls the tourism route an e-Visa, makes citizens of all countries eligible, and says a visa certificate is received by email.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

sources.title: Ukraine MFA: entry regime for Zimbabwean travel passports
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: Ukraine MFA's current country-and-travel-document table records Zimbabwe: visa, while its linked visa guidance routes required-visa applicants to Ukrainian embassies or consulates.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Zimbabwe | visa. Every foreigner ... required to have an entry Ukrainian visa may apply ... to the relevant Ukraine's Embassy or Consulate.

policies.title: Zimbabwean ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's current official tourism guidance requires a tourist visa for a non-resident Zimbabwean visitor and provides an electronic tourist-visa route online from anywhere outside the United States.
conditions: Use a valid ordinary Zimbabwean passport, obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel and complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros declaration.
The tourist visa is single-entry for up to 90 days, extendable for a further 90 days. Work, residence, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Apply with a valid ordinary Zimbabwean passport before departure.
Complete D'Viajeros and travel with the resulting visa code and required travel documents.

policies.title: Zimbabwean ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Côte d'Ivoire's official valid-ordinary-passport process gives online preapproval and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: Complete pre-enrolment, payment and document upload; board only with the approved D.S.T. response, payment receipt, valid ordinary passport and yellow-fever certificate.
At Abidjan airport complete biometric enrolment; the visa is printed and issued there. This is online preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa.

application.label: Côte d'Ivoire official e-visa pre-enrolment
steps: Wait for the D.S.T. approved response before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

policies.title: Zimbabwean ordinary passports: Nigeria electronic tourism visa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service makes its tourism e-Visa available to citizens of all countries and issues the visa certificate by email.
conditions: Use the Nigeria Immigration Service tourism e-Visa route with a valid ordinary Zimbabwean passport, return ticket, accommodation evidence and other current portal requirements.
Apply, upload documents, pay online and obtain the visa certificate by email before travel. Work, residence, other visa classes and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Zimbabwean ordinary passports: Ukraine advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Ukraine MFA's current travel-passport table requires a visa for Zimbabwean citizens, and its visa guidance routes required-visa applicants to Ukrainian embassies or consulates before travel.
conditions: Apply to the relevant Ukrainian embassy or consulate before travel; this is an advance consular route, not an eVisa or visa-on-arrival classification.
War-related border, air-access, occupied-territory permit, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate from this visa classification.

conflicts.explanation: SNEDAI requires approved pre-enrolment before travel but prints and issues the visa at Abidjan airport; online preapproval followed by border issuance is visa_on_arrival.
